A six-real-dimensional Calabi-Yau threefold is the standard 10D->4D string compactification comparator; direct 11D->4D minimal supersymmetry instead naturally points to a seven-real-dimensional G2-holonomy space.

OSp(1|32) is useful in historical/algebraic discussions of 11D supersymmetry but should not be labeled simply 'the M-theory symmetry group'.
